notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own logic (chk-maps run 64). The 64 spawns stand in a holding room at z 9048 over a teleport to `level1`; the start is a box round that arrival. Sections level1..level22 (with ekstra1..7 side checkpoints) follow, each block behind the anti-standing trap below. The last section (level22) runs south-west to [-9000, -4320, 3112]; 600 units below its end is the only trigger that shows the map's credit (`message`, a game_text 'bhop_nature - Created by BLEND'), in a closed room the route drops into. That trigger is the finish. Not published.
